snippet.title: Dominus Gladiatus - Announcement Trailer
snippet.description:
Wishlist Now on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/3572090/Dominus_Gladiatus/

Build your Ludus. Train gladiators. Fight for glory.
Dominus Gladiatus is a brutal gladiator management simulator where you lead your school to glory in the arenas of ancient Rome.
